meaning: Input mains power or battery supply is not available
possible_causes: Mains failure, battery depletion, power cable disconnected, internal supply fault
immediate_safety_action: Keep backup ventilation ready and disconnect patient only after clinical safety assessment.
troubleshooting_steps: Check mains power. Verify battery status. Inspect cables. Confirm power switch state. Run self-test.
recommended_solution: Restore approved power source before use. Escalate if persistent.
verification_before_return_to_service: Confirm normal power indicator and self-test pass.
